brief:
Make a website for CodeSprint Pune 2027, a two-day student and professional hackathon in Pune. Participants should be able to compare the three tracks, work out what they will pay with a fee calculator, register their team with a form, see the day-one and day-two schedule, see the prizes for each track, read FAQs, and see sponsors by tier. Mentors should be able to sign up with a separate form. Add a countdown to the start of the hackathon, a menu that stays on screen and shows which section you are in, and a high-contrast mode that works across the whole page. It should feel energetic and clear and work well on phones.
Day one: Saturday 6 March 2027. Day two: Sunday 7 March 2027. Venue: Lakeside Tech Hall, 12 Lake Road, Pune 411002. Tracks: Web Track (team size 1 to 4, build time 24 hours, first prize Rs 50000); AI Track (team size 2 to 4, build time 24 hours, first prize Rs 75000); Hardware Track (team size 2 to 4, build time 30 hours, first prize Rs 60000). Entry fee per participant: Student Rs 400, Professional Rs 800. Meal pass: Rs 200 each, optional. Early-bird: 10% off entry fees only (not meal passes) for registrations up to 15 February 2027. Fee calculator: choose ticket type (Student or Professional), number of participants (1 to 4) and number of meal passes; show the total. Registration form: team name, lead name, lead email, lead phone, track (dropdown), ticket type (Student or Professional), college name (only shown if ticket type is Student, and required only then), number of participants (1 to 4), meal passes yes/no, dietary preference (Vegetarian or Non-vegetarian, only shown if meal passes is yes); sends to register@example.com. Mentor form: name, email, area of expertise (Web, AI, Hardware), available Saturday / Sunday / both; sends to mentors@example.com. Schedule: Day one 9:00am check-in opens, 10:00am opening and kickoff, 1:00pm lunch, 8:00pm mentor round. Day two 10:00am final submissions close, 11:00am demos begin, 3:00pm prize ceremony. FAQs: Can I change my track? Yes, until 20 February 2027 by email. Is there parking? Yes, free at the north gate. Are refunds available? No. Do I need my own laptop? Yes. Is there Wi-Fi? Yes, at the hall. Can I join without a team? Yes, we will match you with a team on day one. Sponsors: Gold: Northwind Cloud; Silver: Bytecraft Labs, Circuit House; Community: Pune Coders Club. Contact: code@example.com, WhatsApp +91 00000 55555. No photos yet, use placeholders for photos and sponsor logos.
outcome: Done: the site is workable. Every done-when item passes with Audit's evidence and the render check is clean.

done_when.criterion: The page shows the name CodeSprint Pune 2027, the venue Lakeside Tech Hall, 12 Lake Road, Pune 411002, and the dates Saturday 6 March 2027 and Sunday 7 March 2027
The page shows the contact details code@example.com and WhatsApp +91 00000 55555
A track comparison shows Web Track, AI Track and Hardware Track with team size, build time and first prize for each
The page shows entry fees (Student Rs 400, Professional Rs 800), the optional meal pass at Rs 200 each, and the early-bird 10% off entry fees only up to 15 February 2027
A fee calculator takes ticket type (Student or Professional), number of participants (1 to 4) and number of meal passes, and shows the total with the early-bird discount applied to entry fees only

A registration form has team name, lead name, lead email, lead phone, track dropdown, ticket type, college name (shown and required only for Student), number of participants (1 to 4), meal passes yes/no and dietary preference (Vegetarian or Non-vegetarian, shown only if meal passes is yes), and sends to register@example.com
A separate mentor form has name, email, area of expertise (Web, AI, Hardware) and availability (Saturday, Sunday or both), and sends to mentors@example.com
The schedule lists Day one and Day two with every time and event given in the brief
The prizes section shows the first prize for each of the three tracks
An FAQ section answers all six questions given in the brief
A sponsors section shows Gold, Silver and Community tiers with the named sponsors and logo placeholders, and photo placeholders are present
A countdown to the start of the hackathon on 6 March 2027 is shown and updates live
A menu stays on screen while scrolling and highlights the section currently in view
A high-contrast mode toggle changes the colours of the whole page and can be switched back
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
